title: Fixed Scissor Lift Platform
description: One original low-poly static scissor lift platform at one fixed raised height, counted as one prop: an open rectangular ground frame, independent upper support frame and broad thick top platform. Each side has two separate thick crossed arms with three real octagonal through-bores. The layers have positive clearance, with a fixed center pin passing through both actual center holes. Four fixed bored ear seats and four short real through-slots with separate bored fixed rollers carry the arm endpoints to the frames. Fixed pins have small finite radial seating overlaps; these are static visual joints, not moving mechanical fits. All solids have finite ground-connected support paths. Opaque constant PBR colours, no texture, overlay, text, cargo, person, pallet, hydraulics, animation or surrounding scene. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, ground-level origin. Static visual geometry only.
